svg.title: Distance from the exact energy by system size, one panel per method family
svg.desc: tensor network: 82 energies; transformer / ViT: 20 energies; CNN / ResNet: 31 energies; RNN: 38 energies; RBM: 60 energies; mean field: 12 energies; backflow / Pfaffian: 46 energies; other NQS: 11 energies; classic VMC: 48 energies; AFQMC / GFMC: 3 energies; VQE / circuit: 45 energies; other: 5 energies
svg.text: The same distances, one panel per method family
Each panel colours one family's energies over all the others in grey and joins the family's best distance at each size. A method
that only ever ran at one size is a lone mark.
relative distance from the exact energy
relative distance from the exact energy
Families are assigned from the method string (views.mjs), first match wins; 'other' is what none of the patterns name. Filled marks can hold a
record, hollow ones cannot. Axes as in the figure above.
